## What's new

- Crop Overscan: trim the edges an old TV hid, where some games leave flickering tiles or a blank column. For NES (Off, Top & Bottom, All Sides), TurboGrafx-16 (Off, On) and Master System (Off, Left, Both Sides).
- It's in the console's menu (MENU on its shelf) and in the in-game menu, where it shows as soon as the game goes on again. Each console keeps its own choice, through updates.

---

ChaOS 2.1.2 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.1.2-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.1.2-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
